chunks: From him, from al-Qasim, from Ali, from Abi Basir, from Abi Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
I asked him about a woman who dies and leaves no heir other than her husband. He said, 'The inheritance is all for him.'
ai.seo_question: What happens to a woman's estate if she dies with no heirs other than her husband?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the principle of 'ghalabat al-warith' (dominance of the heir), where the husband receives the entire estate in the absence of descendants or ascendants. While the Quranic verse 4:11 specifies a half-share for the husband when children exist, this hadith establishes that the remaining half-share is absorbed by the husband when no other primary heirs are present, a view supported by both Shia and Sunni jurists.
